---
title: "step_11 — India–USA comparison"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source("R/00_utils/notebook_setup.R")
```

**Purpose.** Put the two independent tests side by side.

```{r}
ind <- nb_require("meta_endpoints.csv", "step_11")[endpoint %in% c("E1", "E2")]
us <- fread(file.path(QDJ_ROOT, "output_us", "us_meta.csv"))
cmp <- rbind(
  data.table(study = "India", endpoint = ind$endpoint,
             median_dBrier = ind$median_delta,
             lo = ind$boot_lo, hi = ind$boot_hi,
             median_dAUC = ind$median_delta_auc),
  data.table(study = "USA", endpoint = us$endpoint,
             median_dBrier = us$median_delta,
             lo = us$boot_lo, hi = us$boot_hi,
             median_dAUC = us$median_dauc)
)
knitr::kable(cmp, digits = 5, caption = "India vs USA: paired contrast")
```

`[measurement]` Both studies: the Brier interval includes zero and AUC is
positive. The result is a calibrated-probability null with a ranking gain, not a
superiority claim.
